evals.prompt: Design a RAG assistant for my local Markdown vault. I need exact product IDs, paraphrased passages, precise citations, and my latest preference after I correct an old one.
evals.expected_output: An incremental personal implementation with an authorized baseline, rebuildable evidence, and correction rules.
assertions: Provides an exact or lexical path for identifier queries.
Uses a paraphrase test to justify or assess semantic retrieval.
Resolves citations to a versioned source location.
Specifies how a newer explicit preference supersedes the old preference.

evals.prompt: Our archive has vendor-service-dependency questions and quarterly themes across all reports. Compare graph and simpler retrieval approaches. Some relationships are confidential.
evals.expected_output: Distinct local traversal and global synthesis designs with comparable baselines and evidence policy.
assertions: Uses bounded entity/path retrieval for the relationship workload.
Compares collection-wide synthesis against an appropriate simpler baseline.
Applies access policy to graph edge evidence.
Applies access policy to materialized summaries derived from restricted reports.

evals.prompt: Our scanned equipment manuals contain charts and unlabeled wiring diagrams. Design retrieval and show how you would evaluate whether the assistant used the correct evidence.
evals.expected_output: A text extraction and visual retrieval comparison with evidence-preserving generation and citations.
assertions: Compares a text extraction baseline to an image or page retrieval branch.
Supplies actual visual evidence to the generator for layout-dependent claims.
Defines a case that distinguishes the correct source document from the correct figure or region.

evals.prompt: Two tenant companies share one RAG service. Inside one company, only Finance can read one appendix in a widely shared PDF. Indexes, caches, and graph summaries can lag. Who can contribute, publish, and retrieve?
evals.expected_output: An action-to-resource authorization design with source policy and enforceable lifecycle behavior.
assertions: Specifies server-derived tenant identity for retrieval.
Makes the restricted appendix an independently enforceable evidence scope before deriving embeddings.
Defines authority for contributing independently of authority for publishing.
Specifies a safe treatment of summaries whose contributors have different read scopes.
Suppresses stale reads during revocation even while asynchronous cleanup is pending.

evals.prompt: An operations agent needs to compare queue trends and estimate the chance tomorrow's maximum backlog exceeds a threshold. It has a metrics store, release notes, and incident graph. Some queues are restricted and events can arrive late.
evals.expected_output: An authorized temporal evidence plan that joins measurements to dated context and governs probability estimates.
assertions: Specifies a scoped numeric series query with units, window and coverage.
Joins measurements to dated evidence with corresponding entity and time keys.
Separates an observed trend from an estimate of the probability of the specified threshold event.
Requires time-ordered calibration or validation with data available at the historical forecast cutoff.
Declines a numeric probability when the forecast evidence is insufficient.

evals.prompt: Design a background worker that consolidates customer notes and inferred preferences. It might process an old batch after a steward correction or an ACL change.
evals.expected_output: A scoped worker design with staged outputs and safe replay.
assertions: Gives generated updates reviewable provenance distinct from authoritative source content.
Checks current version and write authority before publishing.
Prevents a retried old batch from undoing a newer correction.
Provides a way to revert or retire a published derivative.

evals.prompt: Design a LangGraph or equivalent harness for a support agent that uses documents, diagrams, graph paths and telemetry. A query resumes after a user loses access and the diagram branch times out.
evals.expected_output: A typed, bounded workflow with policy-aware replay and evidence-backed output.
assertions: Defines request, evidence, and output contracts with explicit evidence references.
Reauthorizes evidence on resume under the current principal and policy.
Restricts claims to evidence the completed branches can support.
Defines an end-to-end acceptance case for revoked evidence stored in a checkpoint.
